annotations.title: Turn WHOIS privacy on or off

description: Turn WHOIS privacy (ID protection) on or off for a domain registered at GlobalHostia, where the extension supports it. Turning it off can publish the registrant's name, email and address in WHOIS, so turning off needs confirm: true after the customer approves.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the customer has explicitly confirmed this exact change.

domain.description: A domain on your account, e.g. mybrand.com

name: set_whois_privacy
